query: How do I add a bookmark on my Kindle?
expected_answer: Press the Menu button while reading and select the bookmark option. You can place bookmarks at any location and have multiple bookmarks in the same book. To view all your bookmarks, press Menu > View Notes & Marks.

query: How do I add and share a note on my Kindle?
expected_answer: While reading, press Menu and select 'Add a Note or Highlight'. Move the cursor to the location where you want to add your note. Type your note (maximum 100 characters). Then use the 5-way to highlight 'save & share' and press the 5-way to save and share it.

query: How do I transfer audiobooks to my Kindle?
expected_answer: Connect your Kindle to your computer using the USB cable. Your Kindle will appear as an external USB drive. Open it and find the 'audible' folder — drag your audiobooks into that folder. Then eject the Kindle from your computer. The transferred audiobooks will appear in Home.

query: How do I connect my Kindle to a WiFi network?
expected_answer: Press Home then Menu, go to Settings, and select 'view' next to Wi-Fi Settings. A list of detected networks appears — select rescan if your network is not listed. Select 'connect' next to your network (a lock symbol means a password is required). Enter the password using the keyboard, pressing the Symbol key for numbers or special characters, then choose 'submit'. Once connected, Kindle automatically reconnects to that network whenever it is in range. To disconnect, select 'forget' next to the network in the Wi-Fi Settings list.

query: Can I read my Kindle while it is charging from a computer?
expected_answer: You need to eject the Kindle from the computer first to release it from USB drive mode. Once ejected, you can continue reading while it charges.

query: Will an e-book bought from Amazon be in the archive forever?
expected_answer: An e-book you purchase from Amazon will be automatically backed up on their servers. If you remove the book from your device, it will appear in your Archived Items, and you can download it again anytime you wish. This means it will remain in your Archived Items 'forever' as long as you have not deleted your account or the content specifically

query: Can a Kindle e-book be lent or borrowed?
expected_answer: You can share your favorite book with any friend who has a Kindle or uses one of our Kindle applications on supported devices. To lend books, go to the Manage Your Kindle page on Amazon. http://www.amazon.com/manageyourkindle (U.S. and other countries)

query: Will my Kindle still receive subscriptions while it is sleeping but has a network connection?
expected_answer: Yes. If wireless was on before the Kindle went to sleep, it will continue to receive scheduled subscriptions during sleep

query: My Kindle is not connecting to WiFi
expected_answer: Check WiFi is enabled in Settings. Restart the Kindle. Forget the network and reconnect by re-entering the password. Check other devices can connect to the same network to rule out a router issue. If nothing works, try a manual network entry or contact Amazon support.

query: What should I do if my Kindle content is corrupted or only partially downloaded?
expected_answer: Delete the content and re-download it. From Home, use the 5-way controller to select the content, press the left arrow on the 5-way to delete, and press the 5-way to confirm. Then open Archived Items in Home, select the content, and press the 5-way to re-download it.

query: My Kindle won't turn on
expected_answer: Charge your Kindle using the power adapter plugged into an AC outlet. Make sure the charging light next to the micro-USB port lights up. Charge for at least 30 minutes. Then slide and release the power switch. If it still does not turn on,reset it: disconnect from power, slide and hold the power switch for 15 seconds then release. The screen will be blank for about 30 seconds while it restarts.

query: I'm having problems transferring content from my computer to Kindle.
expected_answer: Connect your Kindle directly to your computer's USB port instead of a USB hub or keyboard. If already connected directly, try a different USB port. If you have anti-virus software installed, turn it off temporarily before transferring content.

query: Is that the same technology that makes it readable in sunlight?
expected_answer: Yes. Kindle uses electronic paper (eInk) which is a reflective display — unlike most screens, it can be read clearly even in bright sunlight. It also does not need power to hold the ink in place, which helps extend battery life. The page flash and sunlight readability are both characteristics of the same electronic paper technology.

query: Does a kindle emit the same type of light as a phone/computer and feel like you're looking at a 'screen'?
expected_answer: No. Kindle uses electronic paper (eInk) which is reflective — it works using ink particles displayed electronically, like books and newspapers, not like a phone or computer screen which emit light. Because it is reflective, you can read it clearly even in bright sunlight, unlike most displays. It does not need power to hold the ink in place, which also extends battery life.
